kl.execution: Initial version uses an exact teacher-forced reference/policy KL pass after the generation cohorts; no duplicate task-reward backward. Release generation activation pools before teacher activation offload to avoid double-counting host RAM.

surrogate.on_policy_overlap: At the unchanged rollout policy the ratio is exactly 1, so the clipped surrogate derivative equals the advantage-weighted recorded score derivative. No stale gradients or multiple PPO epochs.

execution.framework: Extend PrimeRL orchestrator/optimizer/checkpoint/monitor interfaces with recorded-gradient backend; use the qualified PSStreamingWorker and pinned optimized vLLM source
execution.within_version: Asynchronous vLLM continuous batching plus background recorded backward; rewards apply to completed score gradients
execution.board_assignment: One board per GPU on 8-GPU layout; two four-request cohorts produce the eight rollouts; four-GPU fallback handles two boards per GPU while preserving global64
execution.concurrency_qualification: Four/GPU is the host-memory ceiling for the current C1024 kernel, not yet a measured 4B GPU fit. Reduce only physical concurrency if full buffer accounting/first actual batch needs it; preserve board/group/global batch and objective. No standalone performance smokes.
execution.group_storage: Reduce completed score gradients into CPU G/H accumulators; after all eight rewards, use (H - mean_R * G) / (sample_std_R + 1e-4). No leave-one-out correction. Release private GPU gradients after safe reduction.
execution.interactive_rollouts: Implemented persistent vLLM sampler hook with a system-only initial prompt; first observation and later feedback/template tokens are forced outputs with labels -100. Native thinking/actions are retained with sampled-token labels. Transport padding after game end is excluded from task transcript and loss. Driver must ignore EOS and abort only after native completion/resource termination.
